claim: The maximum number of actions in a single DynamoDB transaction increased from 25 to 100. Older material and older exam questions may still say 25.
question: How many actions can one DynamoDB transaction hold now, and what was the old limit?

qualifiers.condition: the post was published in September 2022

evidence.quote: The maximum number of actions in a single transaction has now increased from 25 to 100.

claim: On November 13, 2024 DynamoDB introduced warm throughput for on-demand and provisioned tables, which gives visibility into the number of read and write operations a table can instantaneously support and lets you pre-warm tables.
question: When was DynamoDB warm throughput introduced and what does it do?

values.display: ability to pre-warm your DynamoDB tables

evidence.quote: | [DynamoDB introduces warm throughput for on-demand and provisioned tables](#DocumentHistory) | DynamoDB now supports warm throughput. Warm throughput provides visibility into the number of read and write operations your DynamoDB table can instantaneously support as well as the ability to pre-warm your DynamoDB tables. For more information, see [DynamoDB warm throughput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/warm-throughput.html). | November 13, 2024 |
